Verified by test_c01_analytical_receptive_fields, test_c01_empirical_rf_support_impulse_perturbation (0 out-of-RF violations across all test positions), and test_c01_receptive_field_endpoints_tightness (endpoints 4j-8 and 4j+11 have non-zero influence).

Stagewise mappings verified separately in INCREMENTAL_SCHEDULE.md §2 and test_c02_stagewise_mappings_synthetic_stream: Conv1 2..61<-old+64, Pool1 1..30<-old+32, Conv2 2..29<-old+32, Pool2 1..14<-old+16, Conv3 2..13<-old+16. All 5 stages achieve max absolute error = 0.0.

Boundary/new positions enumerated in INCREMENTAL_SCHEDULE.md §3: Left boundary j in {0, 1} (due to left zero-padding in new window) and new positions j in [14, 31] (due to new timesteps t >= 64). Verified by test_c03_conv3_boundary_and_new_positions_necessity (strictly positive error if old features were blindly reused) and test_c03_dependency_intervals_bounds ([4j-8, 4j+11] strictly within [0, 63] iff j in [2, 13]).

Premises documented in INCREMENTAL_SCHEDULE.md §4: BN eval mode with frozen running buffers, pooling phase origin=0 with shift=64 divisible by pooling strides 2 and 4, coordinatewise normalization invariance, recording continuity. Verified by test_c04_premises_bn_eval_and_buffers, test_c04_premises_pooling_phase_alignment, test_c04_premises_pointwise_normalization_overlap.

INCREMENTAL_SCHEDULE.md §5 explains why H14 (GAP delta) cannot apply: SmallCNN1D has no GAP layer; Flatten(2048)->Linear(128)->ReLU->Linear(12) applies distinct position-specific weight columns W1[:, c*32 + j] vs W1[:, c*32 + j + 16]. Measured min L2 difference is 0.1709 (mean 0.2296). Non-linear ReLU prevents logit delta updates. Full MLP head recomputation is required and takes ~263k FLOPs. Verified by test_c05_head_architecture_no_gap and test_c05_mlp_weights_position_sensitive.

Empirical verification on Dirac impulses, linear ramp signals, 2,414 validation adjacent pairs, and 5,034 test adjacent pairs. All 3,866,112 scalar comparisons in guaranteed Conv3 region j in [2, 13] achieve bitwise equality (max abs error = 0.0). Boundaries j in {0, 1} and j in [14, 15] exhibit non-zero errors. Documented in alignment_validation.json.

Forward hooks cleanly detached in try/finally blocks; zero lingering hooks in model.named_modules(); ReferenceOwner.load().assert_identity() succeeds before and after all tests; frozen model artifacts and weights remain completely unmutated. Verified by test_c07_hook_hygiene_and_reference_identity.

scientific_dispositions: Confirms H12/H13 incremental feature reuse feasibility: Conv3 features for j in [2, 13] match bitwise (max error 0.0) across all 5,034 test pairs.
Falsifies H14 (GAP delta update) for SmallCNN1D: position-dependent Flatten-MLP weights require recomputing the MLP head, precluding logit-level delta updates.
limitations: Universal bitwise equivalence holds for the current CPU/PyTorch backend with AVX-512; cross-backend (e.g. GPU or alternate BLAS) bitwise equivalence requires backend-specific verification.
Feature cache requires contiguous recording with stride=64; any packet drop or recording boundary must trigger fail-closed cache invalidation.
